outcome_exposure_statement: No new Phase-1 held-out success outcome had been generated, inspected, parsed, summarized, or displayed before this amendment.
reason: The completed forensic audit identified ARM8_GRIP16 as the most directly motivated matched-query-rate arm=8 candidate. ARM8_GRIP32 remains frozen, and ZOH8_GRIP16 is added to distinguish retained-chunk progression from scalar gripper persistence.

effective_contrasts.forbidden_comparison: No post-hoc best-of-{ARM8_GRIP16,ARM8_GRIP32} comparison or pooled candidate test.

statistics.credible_positive_evidence: paired risk difference > 0, exact two-sided McNemar p < 0.05, and lower bounds of both paired-block and task-cluster 95% bootstrap CIs > 0
statistics.power_statement: No McNemar power or minimum detectable effect is inferred from N alone because paired-test power depends on the discordant-pair rate.

effective_decision_rule.A: At least one frozen component candidate has credible positive evidence versus H8 and the same candidate has credible positive evidence versus H16.
effective_decision_rule.B: At least one frozen component candidate has credible positive evidence versus H8, but no candidate satisfies Outcome A.
effective_decision_rule.C: Neither ARM8_GRIP16 nor ARM8_GRIP32 has credible positive evidence versus H8; close the executor branch and do not search additional horizon cells.

zoh8_grip16_semantics.arm: At each query, execute the standard fresh eight-step arm chunk prefix.
zoh8_grip16_semantics.gripper: At steps 0,16,32,... take gripper index 0 from the fresh query at that boundary and hold that scalar unchanged for 16 environment steps.
zoh8_grip16_semantics.forbidden: Never advance through gripper indices 1..15 of a retained chunk; no smoothing, hysteresis, threshold, low-pass, or adaptive logic.

unchanged: Every other field and constraint in protocol.json and PREREGISTRATION.md remains in force unless explicitly overridden above.
